description: Eight modulation sources built from simplex noise: eight voltages that wander smoothly at random rather than stepping, sharing one set of controls.

params.text: Sets how fast the voltage wanders, 0.005 at the left to 5 at the right.
Sets how many octaves of noise are summed into the movement, 1 for a smooth wander through to 8 for one full of small bumps.
Multiplies the noise before it is clipped, 1 at the left to 10 at the right, so higher settings hold the output at -5V or +5V for longer and cross between them faster.

inputs.text: Adds a tenth of its voltage to SPEED, and the total is held inside the knob's own range.
Adds to JITTER, -5V adding nothing and +5V adding five; the total is held inside the knob's own range.

outputs.text: One of the wandering voltages, -5V to +5V; each output is read from a different row of the noise field, so they move at the same speed without following each other.

notes: There is no trigger or clock input: the module runs from the moment it is placed, and an output is only computed while its jack is patched.
